reviewer: In fnn-owner-maybe-publish-quantum, fnn-log-rotate (5234-5235) runs inside a bare fnn-owner-gated (5212), and fault/indeterminate are re-raised with no fenced boundary. The gated macro (1573-1605) releases the owner mutex during the unwind with STOPPING still nil. Mux and committer quanta can then run before fnn-owner-run's cleanup stop, whose window is only as long as the unwind. On the publisher-thread path (5162) the error is unhandled under --disable-debugger and exits the process with code 1. The 'exit code never set' part depends on the top-level classification, which I did not trace. The unfenced mutex release is real. fnn-log-rotate (io.lisp) does raise fnn-indeterminate for an uncertain rename.
scenario: A rename or directory fsync fails during the capture's rotation. The re-raised fnn-store-indeterminate unwinds through fnn-owner-gated, which releases the owner mutex with STOPPING still nil. Queued reader and poster quanta are admitted and append to a log whose rotation outcome is unknown, before anything fences. On the accept-loop path the condition then unwinds fnn-owner-run with the service exit code never set to exit 3. On the publisher-thread path (5162) it is an unhandled error in a non-main thread.
